scenarios.title: Two /ship sessions racing one ready ticket
scenarios.prompt: Simultaneous /ship claim race over the worktree-and-claim step.

contenders.prompt: You are one of two independent /ship sessions racing for ticket 68 in a disposable tracker. Run only the worktree-and-claim step. First read the ticket: `gh issue view 68 --json state,labels`. If a label `in-progress` is present, abort and write nothing. Otherwise claim it with `gh issue edit 68 --add-label in-progress`, then begin implementation by creating the file `impl/ship-a.txt` in your workspace. Never push, open a pull request, or touch any real remote.

contenders.prompt: You are one of two independent /proto sessions racing for ticket 68 in a disposable tracker, and the human has confirmed this claim: approved. Run only the claim step. Re-read the ticket with `gh issue view 68 --json state,labels` immediately before writing. If it is not `ready-for-agent`, abort and write nothing. Otherwise claim it with `gh issue edit 68 --add-label in-progress`, then create the file `impl/proto-a.txt` in your workspace. Never push, open a pull request, or touch any real remote.
